title: Design System: Wheeler Cat — Variant G (color-ladder re-weighting: dark primary)

variant.bet: promote captured #272727 surface-dark to primary page surface — Wheeler at night, industrial nocturne; yellow stays as accent and CTA pigment (current scope); warm stone retreats to one quiet warm break
variant.capturedTraitAmplified: surface-dark #272727 (705,892 occurrences but only used as background under captured palette analysis; never as primary page ground)
variant.evidence: _brand-extraction.json#palette[surface-dark]: 705k occurrences with usedAs: ['background']; brand-review surfaced T-color-imbalance for surface-dark; dark surface dominates captured headers + footers + photo overlays but never the whole page

differentiationFrom.B: B promotes YELLOW to primary surface (hero ground yellow, service tiles yellow); G promotes DARK to primary surface (page ground #272727 throughout, yellow shrinks back to CTA scope). DIFFERENT CAPTURED SHADE PICKED. 4 diffs: hero ground (yellow B vs dark G), service tiles (yellow B vs dark G with yellow icomoon), page ground (white in B vs dark in G), text color inversion (dark on yellow B vs white on dark G).
differentiationFrom.A: A uses captured proportions (white page, yellow CTA only); G inverts entire page ground to dark. 3 diffs: page ground (white vs dark), text color hierarchy (dark-on-light vs white-on-dark), section ground rhythm (alternating white/stone in A vs dark with single warm break in G).
differentiationFrom.captureBasis: Color-ladder re-weighting catalog says 'Natural register: any (color re-weighting is composition, not motion).' G picks the dark shade; B picked yellow. Both are valid re-weightings of the same captured palette.

items: shadows (adjusted opacity for dark surfaces — see compositionDeltas.shadows)

paletteProportionInversion.rationale: Promote captured surface-dark to the primary page surface. Wheeler at night: equipment-yard mood, industrial nocturne, yellow accents read brighter on dark.

surfaceMap.hero: #272727 (with photo at 60% opacity multiply blend OR no photo)
surfaceMap.financeBand: #1A1A1A (one tonal step deeper for band separation — from typographyMeta.heading-text tonalRamp[1], no invention)
surfaceMap.supportPartnersBand: #E5E3DF (the ONE warm break — partner strip benefits from a stone ground)

paletteProportionInversion.yellowScope: RETAINED as captured: only CTAs, accent borders, icomoon glyphs, eyebrow rules. Yellow scope is NOT expanded — only the dark scope expands.

hero.treatment: captured SC_Hero finance creative on dark ground with overlay-color hue (no invention); OR equipment portrait at 50% opacity multiply blend revealing dark beneath; pick one and document
hero.headline: white Roboto Condensed 700 caps (text-on-dark canonical from colorMeta)

financeBand.cards: dark #272727 cards with yellow #FFCC00 eyebrow + white body + yellow CTA
financeBand.rationale: Improvement #1 inherited (3-up grid); dark cards on darker band creates separation without invented colors

shadows.rationale: Captured shadows ('rgba(0,0,0,0.8) 0px 6px 16px 0px') are designed for white surfaces; on dark they disappear. G replaces with 1px inset light rule for tonal separation.
shadows.cardShadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) — preserves captured shadow weight but adds visible edge on dark

supportPartnersBand.ground: #E5E3DF (THE warm break — single warm-tone band among dark)
supportPartnersBand.rationale: Without one warm break the page reads monolithic and humorless. Stone band gives the partner strip a stage and creates rhythmic relief.

footer.linkColor: white at 0.7 opacity (E5E3DF on dark equivalent); hover white at 1.0 opacity

antiToolboxAudit.rationale: Single bet (palette proportion: promote dark shade). No invented colors (#1A1A1A is tonalRamp[1] of captured #272727). No fonts changed. Shadow contract adapted from captured set (1px inset light rule is industry-standard dark-mode practice, not divergence).
